title: Keeping the bench clean
caption: One cleanup per mess, and sometimes the cleanest fix is a clean bench.
framing: Four fixes, paired as in the IBM Technology video

validate.how: Check the sheet against a real bike
validate.before: A wrong screw size on the instruction sheet
validate.after: The sheet checked against a real bike

compact.how: Replace the binder with a one-page summary
compact.before: A binder of every bike model, for one bike
compact.after: A binder replaced by a one-page summary

curate.how: Keep only the wrenches the job needs
curate.after: Only the wrenches the job needs

prune.before: Old and new instruction sheets pinned up side by side
prune.after: The old sheet pulled down, the new one pinned

fresh.label: The cleanest fix
fresh.text: Start at a clean bench: open a fresh chat and bring only the result, not the whole history.

the-videos-framing.description: the IBM Technology video pairs each mode with one fix: validate, compact, curate, prune. Its closing line says all four fixes work by throwing something away [1].

ibm-context-engineering-failure-modes.title: IBM Technology, Context Engineering for AI Agents: 4 Failure Modes to Avoid

breunig-lists-other-fixes.description: his companion post names six: RAG, tool loadout, context quarantine, pruning, summarization and offloading. Picking fewer than 30 tools improved selection accuracy up to threefold [1].

breunig-how-to-fix-your-context.title: Drew Breunig, How to Fix Your Context

one-fix-per-mode-is-a-simplification.header: One fix per mode is a simplification
one-fix-per-mode-is-a-simplification.description: compaction can launder a bad fact into a clean summary, so it does not repair poisoning; that a fresh window is the thread behind compact and prune is inference, and Anthropic warns overly aggressive compaction loses subtle but critical context [1].

anthropic-effective-context-engineering.title: Anthropic, Effective context engineering for AI agents

four-cleanups.title: Four cleanups
four-cleanups.script: There are four cleanups, one for each mess. Validate: check the sheet against a real bike. Compact: replace the binder with a one-page summary. Curate: keep only the wrenches the job needs. Prune: pull the old sheets down.

fresh-chat.title: Fresh chat
fresh-chat.script: Sometimes the cleanest fix is a clean bench. Start a fresh chat and bring only the result, not the whole history. That is the second actionable, and I come back to it in the last Section.
